lessons.cause: A new domain, aggregate, command or word landed without the repo-wide specs that list it: a context map relationship, the FrameworkBluebooks list, model_check findings, MCP argument names, CLI help snapshots and the specs that pin a bluebook's aggregates.
lessons.check: Run the six named specs when a landing touches a bluebook, a hecksagon or a command.
lessons.fix: Declare the context map relationship, list the bluebook in the hecksagon reference, classify the new MCP argument names, pin the new aggregates in the bluebook's spec, and rewrite the CLI help snapshot by running spec/cli_help_snapshot_spec.rb with SNAPSHOT=rewrite after reading its diff, never by hand.

lessons.cause: A bluebook or command changed and the committed generated output (the reference docs, the README indexes and a domain's glossary) was not rewritten.
lessons.check: Run the three named specs, or compare without writing: exe/hecks RegenerationRun.project_glossary! domain.value=<dir> bluebook.value=<Name> check.value=true --wait for a glossary.
lessons.fix: Regenerate the reference docs and README indexes with exe/hecks language_run.project_reference! --confirm --wait, and a domain's glossary with exe/hecks RegenerationRun.project_glossary! domain.value=<dir> bluebook.value=<Name> --confirm --wait; commit what they changed and never hand-edit the output. regeneration_run.regenerate_corpus! rewrites only the Rust output of the corpus domains.

lessons.cause: A new DSL word has no coverage: an AdapterBuilder method is untested, the word has neither a corpus use nor a named exemption, or the Rust parser pair is not accounted for.
lessons.check: Run the three coverage specs when a DSL word is added.
lessons.fix: Add a DSL example, a named corpus exemption if the word has no corpus use, and the parser's coverage row. The stays_inside word (ADR 0171) is the worked case.

signature: Please tell me who you are
lessons.cause: A spec passes alone and fails in a CI shard: it assumes another spec loaded a constant, it clashes with a top-level constant, or a scratch git repository has no committer identity.
lessons.check: Run the new spec together with its neighbours in a clean detached worktree, the way the CI shards do.
lessons.fix: Require the constant the spec uses from its own file, and give every scratch git repository a local committer identity.

lessons.cause: A spec wrote to the owner's real state: a fixture red flag went into the primary checkout's git directory, or fake events went into the live event tap.
lessons.check: spec/support/live_state_guard.rb fails by name a spec that opens the live tap or moves the checkout's red flag.
lessons.fix: Build the flag and the tap in a temporary directory and name them in the example (checkout:, or an event_tap path in a world).

lessons.cause: A timing budget failed on one slow runner, where the warm median sat just over its ceiling.
lessons.check: The timing budget spec in the test job.
lessons.fix: Rerun the one job first. Only a repeat over the ceiling is a real slowdown, and then find what got slower.

lessons.cause: A commit message carried a Claude attribution trailer, which the repository's rules forbid.
lessons.check: The MainIntegration saga's boarding refuses, by name, a range that carries an agent's attribution trailer. SendTrain.board! does not check, so read the range's messages before boarding the train.
lessons.fix: Amend the commit message to remove the trailer line: no Co-Authored-By line and no Claude-Session line.
lessons.enforced_by: MainIntegration boarding refuses a range with an agent's attribution trailer (MainIntegration::RangeGuard through MainBoarding, ab08527fd). Not yet enforced: SendTrain.board! (GitTrain#board) runs no RangeGuard; follow-up work item: route the push train's boarding through RangeGuard.

lessons.cause: The push train pushes everything on local main, so commits that sat on local main unverified rode out with the coder's own commit and turned main red.
lessons.check: Board only when local main is ahead of origin/main by exactly your commit (git log origin/main..main), or its tree equals a green tree.
lessons.fix: Restore main to the last green tree, then land each carried commit again through its own landing.
lessons.enforced_by: Not yet enforced: coder 551cebfb builds the guard in the kick.

signature: bind persisted_by by default to different adapters
lessons.cause: A wiring change made an attached framework member inherit persistence from the domains that attach it, and those domains defaulted to different adapters (Memory, PostgresEra), so every boot refused and every job that boots failed.
lessons.check: Boot exe/hecks after a hecksagon or framework wiring change, rebased onto main, before landing.
lessons.fix: Do what the WiringError names: bind the member itself, or make the attaching domains agree on persisted_by. Main was restored to its last green tree (8d47c583b).
